items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Everybody except the drummer, and I don’t know who the tall saxophonist is, but the rest of them I know. That’s me. Minnie – Minnie [?Moore ?Morris].

ctx.x: Yeah, because they’re going to put their own flavor into your arrangement anyway. We have some pictures here that Melba’s going to be looking at, from her childhood, that she’s never seen before. Who do you see on there that you recognize, Melba?
Everybody except the drummer, and I don’t know who the tall saxophonist is, but the rest of them I know. That’s me. Minnie – Minnie [?Moore ?Morris].
